name: model
description: | Produce or update a domain-reference kit — the durable glossary + divergences/traps pages for a bounded context. Use for domain modelling, information architecture, building a domain glossary or domain model, mapping domain concepts to code (bindings), or surfacing the decidable questions stakeholders must close before design. Runs upstream of feature $kk:design as the first producer of the architecture flow, and emits artifacts $kk:review-architecture verifies. Triggers: "model the domain", "
